core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Aakif corresponds to the Arabic form عاكف (Arabic root ع ك ف (ʿ-k-f); عَاكِف (ʿĀkif)). Its core sense is one who stays in devotion, worshipper. persian.name: عاکف
